name: cavemio-badge
title: Badge
description: A status, a tag or a count: statuses ease their colour and morph their word, live dots breathe, counts roll and fold away at zero.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: no breathing ring, the count changes in place.
- Status colours always come with a word, never colour alone.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: dot
props.description: – · A dot before the text; "pulse" breathes.

props.name: count / max / showZero
props.description: – · A rolling number instead of text.

useCases.title: Invoice and order tables
useCases.description: Paid, Pending, Overdue in a status column.

useCases.title: Deploy and build lists
useCases.description: A breathing "Building" dot that settles to "Ready".

useCases.title: Navigation
useCases.description: Unread counts on Inbox and Mentions.

useCases.title: Tags
useCases.description: Plan, role or category labels in outline.

features.title: Tone changes ease
features.description: Background, text and dot colours transition (300ms) as the word morphs.

features.title: Counts that roll
features.description: NumberRoll digits, 99+ cap, fold away at zero.

features.title: Live dot
features.description: A ring breathes out from the dot every 1.6s.

features.title: Five tones, two looks
features.description: neutral, primary, success, warning, danger; filled or outline.

states.title: status change
states.description: Colours ease (300ms) and the word morphs letter by letter.

states.title: live
states.description: With dot="pulse", a ring scales out of the dot and fades (1.6s loop).

states.title: count
states.description: Digits roll the way the count moved; at 0 the badge folds away (320ms) unless showZero.
